name: CE Web-to-Salesforce Middleware
description: Catholic Energies public forms to Salesforce: lookups, Solar Assessment, Desk Audit, Instant Audit, Procurement (stub)

SF_CLIENT_ID.description: Salesforce External Client App Consumer Key

SF_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Salesforce External Client App Consumer Secret

NEW_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED.description: true lets POST /accounts register new organizations (as In Review)

DEMO_MODE.description: true simulates registration and demo-account submissions with no Salesforce writes

EI_UNKNOWN_ID.description: Salesforce Id of the placeholder 'Not Applicable' Ecclesiastical Institution

SCREENING_UPLOAD_SECRET.description: Signs Desk Audit upload tokens (falls back to SF_CLIENT_SECRET)

FREDDIE_JOB_SECRET.description: Shared secret Freddie uses to sign its requests. Required for live Instant Audit.

INSTANT_AUDIT_MOCK.description: true answers Instant Audit from canned examples (no Freddie, no scoring) for form development

INSTANT_AUDIT_SF_WRITE.description: true writes Instant Audit data to Salesforce. Leave off until CR-S3 is live.

INSTANT_AUDIT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated website origins allowed to call Instant Audit. Empty allows any.

LOOKUP_RATE_PER_HOUR.description: Per-connection limit on each lookup (accounts, buildings, institutions). Default 120. 0 turns it off.

SUBMIT_RATE_PER_HOUR.description: Per-connection limit on each of /submit, /screening-request, /screening-complete. Default 20. 0 turns it off.

FILE_RATE_PER_HOUR.description: Per-connection limit on /screening-file (one request per bill). Default 300. 0 turns it off.

REGISTER_RATE_PER_HOUR.description: Per-connection limit on registering a new institution. Default 5. 0 turns it off.

BILL_SETS_ENABLED.description: 8.2.0 (CR-S4). Leave unset/false until the Salesforce change request is live and the mail settings below are tested. When true: bills are saved as sets that can be reused after email verification, and Instant Audit uses Instant_Audit_Status__c.

BILLS_REUSE_DAYS.description: How long an uploaded bill set can be reused. Default 395 (about 13 months).

BILLS_SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs verification sessions (falls back to SCREENING_UPLOAD_SECRET). Sessions end if this changes.

MAIL_PROVIDER.description: postmark or sendgrid. Sends the verification code. (log is for development only.)

MAIL_API_KEY.description: API key (Postmark server token or SendGrid key) for MAIL_PROVIDER.

MAIL_FROM.description: Sender address, verified with the mail provider, e.g. no-reply@catholicenergies.org

BILLS_STAFF_TASK_OWNER_ID.description: Salesforce User Id (005...) who receives 'bill reuse help requested' tasks.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: This app's public address, used in report links, e.g. https://ce-web-to-sf-middleware.herokuapp.com

REPORT_LINK_SECRET.description: Signs report download links (falls back to FREDDIE_JOB_SECRET)
